description: Per close of a segment, settled answers bucketed by the epoch each answer was born (origin): settled, sealed (at least one jury seat), passed, expired_no_jury (expired with no jury; not failed), failed (jury failures only), paid (passed and the author got a challenge payout at that close), not_paid (juried, not paid; expiries excluded), beside the rows still open at that close and how many had a panel. From the public close records. Pending scores are never read. close= keeps one close. CSV at /api/v1/governance/settlement.csv. Use it to see how answers from each origin epoch settled, sealed and got paid.

close.description: one close (epoch number); omit for every close

limit.description: maximum rows to return (1 to 5000, default 200)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

name: get_settlement_by_origin
title: Settlement by origin epoch
